Work intensification

The impact on workers and trade union strategies to tackle work intensification
Author Matt Creagh
Report type Research and reports
Issue date 25 Jul 2023
Introduction

The TUC is the voice of Britain at work. We represent more than 5.5 million working people in unions across the economy.

This report is a compilation of trade union case studies showing how work intensification is a growing problem.

What is work intensification?

Work intensification has been defined as the rate of physical and mental input to work tasks performed during the working day.

  • Reference note for the report definition.
1 – What is work intensification?

Work intensity describes the amount of work completed in a given period and the effort needed to complete it.

  • Workers report that rising workloads reduce their control over the working day.
